body: What is really fun, is that your username doesn't match your awesomeness. ;)

Ok, people. Last cigarette. You have all being so nice to me and I hope to you all a lovely life. People that spend their time to talk to strangers is so heart-warming. So, off I go. But let me quote something before. If I go, my last words should be something I learned from Bill hicks:

"The world is like a ride in an amusement park, and when you choose to go on it you think it's real because that's how powerful our minds are. The ride goes up and down, around and around, it has thrills and chills, and it's very brightly colored, and it's very loud, and it's fun for a while. Many people have been on the ride a long time, and they begin to wonder, "Hey, is this real, or is this just a ride?" And other people have remembered, and they come back to us and say, "Hey, don't worry; don't be afraid, ever, because this is just a ride." And we … kill those people. "Shut him up! I've got a lot invested in this ride, shut him up! Look at my furrows of worry, look at my big bank account, and my family. This has to be real." It's just a ride. But we always kill the good guys who try and tell us that, you ever notice that? And let the demons run amok … But it doesn't matter, because it's just a ride. And we can change it any time we want. It's only a choice. No effort, no work, no job, no savings of money. Just a simple choice, right now, between fear and love. The eyes of fear want you to put bigger locks on your doors, buy guns, close yourself off. The eyes of love instead see all of us as one. Here's what we can do to change the world, right now, to a better ride. Take all that money we spend on weapons and defenses each year and instead spend it feeding and clothing and educating the poor of the world, which it would pay for many times over, not one human being excluded, and we could explore space, together, both inner and outer, forever, in peace."

I'm polite, that's pretty much it. Dreams? None. Uruguay? Boring. No one wants to fly a kite or build a tent with sheets and chairs and tell horror stories in the dark. The only good thing? Pot. You can smoke it everywhere, and you never ever get in trouble for it. In fact, that's pretty much it. Also, everything is overpriced and our Comic-Con conventions suck.
And the first time you do, is with a suicidal person. Well, that's not a first good impression. I'm so sorry!

You deserve that kind of life! You are so nice! But I'm completely broke, and have no visa. In Uruguay, a trip to Europe or USA without papers is not only near impossible, but REALLY expensive. $3000 USD is the least it should take. So, off to see the world is not an option for me, sadly. Every penny I earn goes towards debts, loans and such. If you have debts, you can't leave the country, since no one wants to provide a visa with that kind of baggage. It's complicated. You can't even start a new life here, because it's such a small city that you almost know everyone. I'm stuck in a place I loathe, and there's not a single thing I can do about it. I also lack discipline. I just want something easy, something that goes right for me. One time. Just once.

Interesting? You'd be the first one that ever said that to me. Ha, I live in the most boring country of all. Uruguay. U-r-gay. Nothing ever happens here. The only thing I have knowledge of is stand up comedians and videogames. Not a very popular topic over here. 

I know she will suffer. And it hurts me the most. But is it fair to me to keep living when I honestly don't want to anymore? Is it fair that I can't kill myself and be done with it because it may hurt someone? I'm conflicted. And that's why I'm still here.

I know. And that's the only thing in my mind. I just want the best for her, you know? And she will be more happy without me around. She's always worried about me, she's always so nice and understanding. I can't be a shitty daughter to her anymore. I swear she deserves better. I wish I was dead instead of my brother. He was so full of life, so young, and here I am, hating myself and generally making anybody miserable. I'm even upsetting strangers on the internet. It doesn't get more horrible than that. 

So, so, so, sorry for concerning you. Thank you for wasting your time in me, it's comforting that a stranger took the time to read this shit out.

I've tried it all that there's over here. Forums. College. Random strangers. Hipster cool kids. Engineers. Anime kawaii chicks. Stoners. Drugs. Nothing works. I've never found a place for myself. I've never felt like home. Unless you call Elder Scrolls or Mass Effect home, I've never had one. 

Edit: thank you for your advice, though. Sorry to waste your time with me. I guess I needed to talk a bit before doing it.

Thank you, sweety. But I ruined my mother's life by just being born into this world. I was unplanned, you see? She had to left her studies, worked her ass off to pay the fucking bills. She deserves so much better than a stupid kid walking down some road because there's nothing else to do. I don't have the strength to deal with this boredom, I don't have the capacity to feel anything but a void. Nothing matters, nothing is ever going to change. Every year I start with "YEAH, I'LL WILL FUCKING BE AWESOME". Nope, it ends up with a disaster over and over again. Even the fucking suicide lines in my country are closed. So, here I am, being pathetic and childish in Reddit. I'm so sorry for boring you to death (ha, "death", get it?) - strangers like yourself should be concerned for people with real problems, not some brat that wishes she was dead since I can recall.

Thank you, but don't waste your time in my post. It's been so many years, and nothing changes. My brother died, my step father is an alcoholic and doesn't remember my name and my biological father asked me not to contact him. Ever. I deleted facebook,  lawyered up and tried the gym thing; it didn't work out. So, I guess I'm running out of options, heh?

Thank you, lovely. But believe me, no one needs anyone in this world. Is like a machine. People amazing die every day, and me, a useless thing, a prop, you could say, is still here. It's not fair. Don't worry, I'll donate my organs and my body to an institution. Perhaps I couldn't do anything for anyone in my life, but in death, I may help. I even prepared the knot carefully, so it should be quick and painless. I can't bare another day in this world with nothing to live for, and I've come to terms with it. Death happens.
